## How it was tested

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] End-to-end specs run for the areas changed (`pnpm test:e2e <spec>`), if behavior changed
- [ ] `apps/server/test/ai-capabilities.mjs` run on both providers, if the AI prompt or tools changed
- [ ] README, SECURITY.md and `.env.example` updated, for new settings or behavior
